elections.quote: Do I really buy that Texas could turn blue?. Some of the skepticism about James Talarico’s chances amounts to superstition. But I have one lingering concern about our forecast in Texas.

Are Democrats on a summer sugar high?. They’re polling surprisingly strongly in some Senate races. But should you bet on those numbers falling back to earth? Plus, some quick thoughts on Alaska and Florida.

Everything is breaking Democrats’ way. Is it enough to win the Senate?. Our midterms model finds that polls, fundamentals and history all point toward a strong Democratic year. The House is theirs to lose, but winning four Senate seats is still a tall order.
